reason: WES/RNA-seq found mutations in SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling genes (PBRM1, ARID1A) but no methylation, histone mark, or chromatin-state assay was performed on the chordoma samples.
RNA-seq of FRDA muscle biopsies showed upregulated chromatin-regulation transcripts, but only gene expression was measured, not an epigenetic mark itself.
HANDLS longitudinal cohort measured genome-wide DNAm to derive DunedinPACE and linked it to race and poverty status, an eligible social exposure.
Skin autofluorescence measures advanced glycation end products, not DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or a DNAm clock.
PAX1/ST6GALNAC5 promoter methylation was measured directly in HPV+ women and evaluated as a triage test for HSIL+/cervical cancer, a clinical screening decision.
RIMS2 promoter methylation was measured by Illumina EPIC array in paired CRC/normal tissue and FFPE tumours and shown to predict survival.
Imprinting-centre methylation was directly assayed in this prospective Wilms tumour cohort and compared with healthy controls, informing genetic counselling.
The inversion near KANSL1 is only 'predicted to disrupt local chromatin structure' from GWAS/MR; no chromatin assay was actually performed.
H3K36me2/H3K27me3 ChIP-seq marks were measured only in NSD2-mutant B-ALL cell lines; the matched patient cohort supplied RNA-seq (expression) only, not a measured chromatin mark.
The abstract does not make clear whether GNB4 promoter methylation was measured in the 107-patient GC cohort itself or only in the cell-line/mouse mechanistic experiments.
DNA methylation-based subgrouping was integrated with whole-chromosome aberrations across a multi-trial medulloblastoma cohort to build a validated risk-stratification scheme.
LINE-1 global methylation was measured by a validated assay in an autism case-control series and tested as a diagnostic biomarker (AUC reported).
This JSLE study profiles autoantibodies against histone and nucleosome antigens, which is an immune-response measurement, not a measured epigenetic mark.
TPM4's link to 'epigenetic alterations' is inferred from correlation with methylation-inhibitor gene expression in TCGA data, not a direct methylation or chromatin measurement.
The study characterizes DNMT3A/IDH1/IDH2/TET2 mutation status (DMRGM) in AML, which is a genetic mutation panel, not a direct measurement of DNA methylation itself.
This is a survey of primary-care practitioners' dementia-screening knowledge and practice; no epigenetic marker of any kind is involved.
Biological age here is a deep-neural-network score from circulating clinical biomarkers, not a DNA methylation clock or any other eligible epigenetic marker.
Histone genes appear only as a clustered protein-protein-interaction network derived from TCGA data; no histone modification or methylation assay was performed.
This WES association study of athletic performance identifies germline SNPs (e.g., SIRT1, NUP210), not any measured epigenetic mark.
Blood leukocyte DNAm age acceleration was measured via EPIC BeadChip in the China Kadoorie Biobank and linked to incident coronary heart disease risk and lifestyle mediators.
Three DNAm-based biological-age metrics (PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) were measured in the Sister Study cohort and associated with prevalent and incident hypertension.
PHF6's role is shown via protein staining, expression, and cell-line ChIP-qPCR; no chromatin mark was directly measured in patient tissue.
This Mendelian randomisation study draws DNAm associations entirely from published mQTL/eQTL and GWAS summary statistics with no individual-level data, the instrument's stated example of not_primary.
CDKN2B/P15 and NEUROG1 promoter methylation were measured in peripheral blood by MS-HRM in a gastric-cancer case-control study and linked to dietary/lifestyle exposures.
Genome-wide DNAm was measured with EPIC arrays in blood from a very-low-birthweight cohort at birth and age 28 and linked to later cardiovascular monitoring.
This SMR/HEIDI analysis integrates cis-eQTL/cis-mQTL and GWAS summary statistics for stroke risk without measuring methylation in individual participants.
EPIC-array DNAm clocks (GrimAge etc.) were measured in blood at ED presentation in a trauma cohort and used to predict subsequent PTSD diagnosis.
This is a proteomic/network study of FTLD brain tissue; 'chromatin regulation' appears only as a co-expression module label, not a measured epigenetic mark.
This cross-sectional study of SLE first-degree relatives profiles autoantibodies (including anti-histone) and cytokines, not a measured epigenetic mark.

The diagnostic DNAm signature (cg03800765) was discovered via patient-plasma-treated cardiomyocytes and cardiac biopsies; it is unclear whether the reported marker was measured directly in patient tissue or only via this indirect ex vivo assay.
Placental CpG methylation and miRNA expression were measured directly in the ELGAN preterm cohort and linked to ASD case status at age 10.
CpG island methylator phenotype (a directly measured DNA methylation status) was profiled across a 423-patient CRC cohort and linked to prognosis alongside microbiota subtyping.
This is a descriptive case series of 12 patients with one tumour entity (H3 G34-mutant glioma) with no comparison group, despite the 'cohort' label.
Biological heart age here is derived from cardiac MRI radiomics features, not from DNA methylation, histone marks, or any DNAm clock.
DNA methylation profiling was performed prospectively alongside targeted sequencing in over 1200 paediatric CNS tumour patients to improve diagnostic classification.

DNA methylation was profiled directly in this early-onset colorectal cancer cohort, but the abstract does not clearly tie the epigenomic findings to a specific modifiable exposure or clinical decision beyond general molecular characterization.
MGMT promoter methylation and methylome-based classification were measured directly in a 120-patient glioblastoma cohort and compared between long-term and non-long-term survivors.
Blood methylomes were measured before and 4 weeks into risperidone treatment in schizophrenia patients and compared between good and bad responders.
This study identifies pathogenic variants in epigenetic-regulator genes (NSD1, SETD1B, SUZ12) in overgrowth syndromes but does not measure methylation or histone marks themselves.
Blood DNA methylation scores for smoking, BMI, and alcohol were calculated in nested case-control studies within the Melbourne Collaborative Cohort and linked to cancer risk.
DNA methylation array profiling and H3K27me3 immunohistochemistry were directly measured across 147 ependymoma cases in a clinical-trial cohort to optimize diagnostic biomarkers.
JAK2/STAT1/STAT3/SOCS3 promoter methylation was measured by MS-HRM in peripheral blood in a 403 vs 419 case-control study of colorectal cancer risk.
SMYD2 mRNA expression was measured by RT-PCR in childhood B-ALL; the histone methyltransferase's activity/mark itself was not assayed.
The signature is based on m5C RNA methylation regulator genes, a non-coding/RNA modification rather than the DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state markers eligible here.
Chromatin-remodeling gene mutations (loss-of-function) were used as a predictive biomarker in this biliary tract cancer trial, but no epigenetic mark was directly measured.
Blood-based FUT7 hypomethylation was measured by mass spectrometry in large case-control studies and validated as an early lung-cancer detection biomarker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation profiling was performed on archived tissue from a nationwide CNS-PNET cohort and used to reclassify tumours with distinct survival outcomes.
Whole-exome sequencing identified variants in genes annotated to 'DNA methylation regulation', but methylation itself was not measured in these arthroplasty patients.

ACADVL hypermethylation after HIIT was measured in cardiac fibroblasts incubated with patient serum rather than directly in the heart-failure patients' own tissue, making the human-measurement criterion unclear.
Constitutional MLH1 promoter methylation was measured directly in blood across population-based endometrial cancer cohorts to guide germline testing and clinical management.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC array) was measured directly in oral biopsies in a PVL-OSCC vs OSCC case-control study distinguishing a more favourable clinical course.
Sperm chromatin integrity was assessed by TUNEL/TEM in cystic fibrosis patients, which measures DNA strand breakage/packaging rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (RRBS) was measured directly in leukocytes from a cross-sectional Han vs Tibetan T2DM cohort and linked to dietary/lifestyle differences.
The Sperm Chromatin Structure Assay measures acid-induced DNA fragmentation, explicitly excluded as a non-epigenetic chromatin integrity test.
H3K27me3 immunohistochemistry and DNA methylation profiling were measured directly in H3-wild-type diffuse midline glioma tumours and compared against H3K27M DMG.
This is a retrospective incidence/treatment-utilization study of chronic insomnia in military members; no epigenetic marker is involved.
Blood DNAm was used to compute GrimAge acceleration in discovery and replication bipolar-disorder cohorts and compared between suicide attempters and non-attempters.
DNA methylation-based GrimAge was measured in the Health and Retirement Study cohort and its interaction with APOE e4 status on memory performance was tested.
Illumina EPIC methylation arrays were measured directly in a longitudinal infant cohort and linked to maternal obesity/gestational diabetes exposure during pregnancy.
This study measures gait and cognitive performance in a population cohort; no epigenetic marker is assessed.
This 2-sample Mendelian randomisation analysis of GrimAge/PhenoAge acceleration uses only GWAS summary statistics for exposures and outcomes, not individual-level data.
This GWAS/PRS study of early-onset CRC susceptibility identifies germline loci near chromatin-assembly genes but does not measure methylation or chromatin state directly.
Biological age here is derived from 12 clinical indicators via the NHIS health-screening cohort, not from any DNA methylation or chromatin-based marker.
This antiphospholipid-antibody study measures anti-NET antibodies including anti-citrullinated-histone antibodies, an immune measurement rather than a chromatin mark.
Genome-wide and candidate-gene DNAm was measured directly in a mother-child cohort and linked to prenatal SO2 exposure and later ADHD symptoms.
MGMT promoter methylation status was measured directly in a retrospective glioblastoma cohort and compared for progression-free and overall survival.
This is a clinical-audit study of COPD outpatient care processes; no epigenetic marker is involved.
BrainAge here is an MRI-derived structural brain-age gap, not a DNA methylation clock or other eligible epigenetic marker.
Blood DNAm was measured by epigenome-wide association study in the St. Jude childhood cancer survivor cohort and linked to blood lipid levels as exposures/outcomes.

DNAm was measured directly by EPIC array in both cohorts, but the study's purpose is validating concordance between CBC and DNAm immune-cell estimators rather than clearly linking the marker itself to an exposure or clinical decision.
This study develops and validates blood-based DNAm predictors of chronological and biological age (mortality) across multiple prognostic cohorts, an eligible tool-development-in-humans case.
Cord-blood DNAm was measured directly via EPIC/450K arrays in a South African birth cohort and tested as a mediator between indoor air pollution exposure and neurodevelopment.
DNA methylation and copy-number profiling (EPIC array) were measured directly in pediatric BCOR-altered tumour tissue and correlated with survival outcomes.
Biological age in this frailty RCT was measured by bioelectrical impedance analysis, not by any DNA methylation or chromatin-based marker.
Cell-free DNA methylation across 161,984 CpG sites was measured directly in blood in prospective case-control cohorts to validate a multi-cancer early-detection test.
This is a cohort-resource description paper listing available data modalities (including a DNAm array) rather than a primary analysis relating a measured marker to an exposure or outcome.
This retrospective study reports foot-deformity surgery prevalence in MECP2 disorders; no methylation or chromatin mark is measured.
A methylation-based classifier was built and validated on 83 glioneuronal tumour samples with direct DNA methylation array measurement to refine diagnostic stratification.
Saliva DNAm (EPIC array) was measured directly in children of the Lifeways cohort and linked to parental dietary quality, a modifiable prenatal exposure.

This is a deep-learning radiomic classifier predicting MGMT methylation status from MRI images in the public BraTS dataset, a technical/algorithmic tool paper rather than a direct human marker measurement study.
CYSLTR1/CYSLTR2 promoter methylation (CpG M-values) was measured directly in a clinical CRC cohort and linked to prognosis and metastasis prediction.
Horvath epigenetic age was measured by EPIC array in saliva across two follow-up visits in a youth cohort and linked to stressful life events.
Serum citrullinated histone H3 is a circulating protein biomarker assay, explicitly distinguished from a chromatin-state measurement in this instrument.
This is a cytomorphological scoring system for thyroid FNA specimens; no epigenetic marker is involved.
Aging acceleration here is based on leukocyte telomere length and phenotypic age from clinical biomarkers in UK Biobank, neither of which is an eligible epigenetic marker.
This multiomics network study of rectal cancer response uses gene/miRNA/protein expression and tests an HDAC inhibitor in vitro, without directly measuring methylation or histone marks in patients.
Circulating tumour DNA methylation markers were measured directly in plasma from ENKTL patients and used to build diagnostic and prognostic prediction models.
This case-control study measures anti-bacterial and anti-citrullinated-protein (including anti-histone) antibodies in pre-RA sera, not a chromatin mark itself.
Blood DNAm was measured directly and linked to 'time preference', a behavioural/personality trait that is neither a modifiable exposure/intervention nor a stated clinical or public health decision.
Biological age acceleration here is computed from clinical biomarkers via the Klemera-Doubal method, not from DNA methylation or any other eligible epigenetic marker.
H3K9me3 histone modification and SETDB1 expression were measured directly in a pediatric high-grade glioma cohort and correlated with patient survival.
REST's oncogenic role in glioma is shown via TCGA/GTEx expression bioinformatics and cell-line experiments; no methylation or histone mark was directly measured.
The EpiBrain project description uses future tense throughout ('we are conducting', 'will investigate'), identifying it as a study protocol for planned work rather than a completed primary study.
NCAPH2 promoter methylation was measured directly by bisulfite pyrosequencing in blood across a case-control series spanning AD, aMCI, SCD, and controls.
A DNA methylation biomarker panel (ADAMTS1, BNC1, CACNA1G) was measured by methylation-specific PCR directly in IPMN tissue to stratify malignant risk for surgical decisions.
DNAm-based age-acceleration measures (PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) were measured in a representative older-adult panel study and used to predict health outcomes and mortality.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC 850K) was measured directly in an Italian COVID-19 cohort and used to predict severe versus mild disease prognosis at admission.
Regional DNAm at CPT1A was measured directly in blood in a randomised weight-loss diet trial and shown to interact with dietary fat intake on triglyceride change.
Urine-based methylation of three cancer biomarker genes was measured directly by methylation-sensitive PCR in a prospective cohort to diagnose upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
This study reports stem-cell mobilization outcomes after gemtuzumab ozogamicin in AML; no epigenetic marker is measured.
